## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Florence, Italy. It starts at Piazza di Santa Trinita 5R.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Your tickets to the Salvatore Ferragamo Museum in Florence will launch you on the way to discovering the history of the Ferragamo company, the life of its founder and his spectacular creations!
>
> Discover the history of the shoemaker who moved to California from a little village in the province of Naples and began a career designing and creating shoes for the movie industry. Ferragamo returned to Italy in 1927 and opened a workshop in Florence. His creations - like the famous cork wedge heels, metal-reinforced high heels and invisible sandals soon made him famous all over the world.
>
> See them all at the museum in the medieval Palazzo Spini Feroni - the historical headquarters of the company.
